title: Acceleration and Braking
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Acceleration_and_Braking.md
text: Generate steering, accelerator, and brake commands, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Longitudinal acceleration at tStart, ax [g]} sets the longitudinal acceleration at simulation, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {Brake pedal actuation}, {Brake actuation time, tBrake [s]}, {Longitudinal displacement of vehicle CG, xBrake [m]} sets the nominal lateral offset, {Longitudinal deceleration at tBrake, axDecel [g]} sets the deceleration rate, {Set handwheel angle to 0 deg after braking} sets the option to set handwheel angle to zero degrees after, {Enable fault tracking before braking} sets the option to enable fault tracking before, {Transport delay buffer size, bufferSize []}, {Longitudinal velocity and mean longitudinal velocity, velMaxDiff} sets the velocity difference, {Mean longitudinal velocity and longitudinal velocity reference, velMeanDiff} sets the velocity tolerance, {Yaw velocity and mean yaw velocity, rMaxDiff [deg/s]} sets the velocity tolerance, {Handwheel angle and mean handwheel angle, steerMaxDiff [deg]} sets the handwheel angle tolerance and {Stop Simulation when fault occurs} sets the option to stop simulation when fault. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Longitudinal acceleration at simulation start 0.5 (default) | positive scalar
